rules.cwe_name: Direct Request ('Forced Browsing')
rules.description: A restricted route, URL, script, or file can be requested directly without required authorization.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Authorization
rules.description: Not using `pam_acct_mgmt` after `pam_authenticate` to check the validity of a login can lead to authorization bypass.

rules.cwe_name: Missing Release of Resource after Effective Lifetime
rules.description: Opening a file without ensuring that it is always closed may lead to data loss or resource leaks.

rules.cwe_name: Observable Timing Discrepancy
rules.description: When checking a Hash over a message, a constant-time algorithm should be used. Otherwise, an attacker may be able to forge a valid Hash for an arbitrary message by running a timing attack if they can send to the validation procedure. A successful attack can result in authentication bypass.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Private Personal Information to an Unauthorized Actor
rules.description: Logging sensitive information without encryption or hashing can expose it to an attacker.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Using jinja2 templates with 'autoescape=False' can cause a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Access Control
rules.description: An access-control policy is missing or incorrectly enforced for a protected resource.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File
rules.description: From user-controlled data saved in CSV files, it is easy to attempt information disclosure or other malicious activities when automated by spreadsheet software

rules.cwe_name: Sensitive Cookie in HTTPS Session Without 'Secure' Attribute
rules.description: Insecure cookies may be sent in cleartext, which makes them vulnerable to interception.
